notes:
Fix-only application release. v0.2.24 shipped the P4 finding→action entry (per-page button, cross-page batch panel, and the deep-audit finding source) but the Web BFF had no route for the two paths those controls call: POST /api/agent-requests/from-finding and POST /api/agent-requests/from-findings fell through to the dynamic [id] handler (which exports GET only) and returned HTTP 405. This release adds both proxy routes.

How it was found: the P4 production acceptance run added exactly those paths to the list scripts/verify-agent-bff-routing.mts exercises through Caddy → built Next BFF → synthetic API, so the same class of gap is now covered. The list previously had 10 paths and now has 19 (adding from-finding, from-findings, candidate-edits, draft-edit, publication, publication-candidate and the three execution-scoped manual endpoints); the run reports 124 checks instead of 97. All of them passing locally does not replace the CI gate — CI runs the same script.

The user-approved P4 production acceptance for 16 production article pages was attempted twice and wrote nothing. The first attempt stopped in its own preflight (its assertion encoded a wrong premise of mine: those pages are not missing a Meta Description, they carry an over-long one — 193–473 characters against the 120–160 target; of the report's 73 description findings, 44 are genuine misses and nearly all of those are taxonomy/archive/homepage URLs that carry no post object for seo_update, while all 29 over-long ones are .html articles). The second attempt stopped at creation with HTTP 405, before any request existed. Both runs are preserved verbatim: docs/evidence/263-p4-production-acceptance-2026-10-16/p4-production-batch-description-r1.json and -r2.json. The production database still holds zero requests with origin=page_finding.

Database: no migrations in this release. The schema stays exactly at 050 as applied by v0.2.24, so an upgrade from v0.2.24 has nothing to migrate and does not need the worker/dispatcher stop that a migration-bearing upgrade requires.

Rollback target: v0.2.24 application images only. This release changes no schema, no persisted record shape and no configuration contract, so v0.2.24 code runs unchanged against the current database; rolling back simply removes the two proxy routes.

Bootstrap: unchanged from v0.2.24 — no new control-plane protocol, so an installation already on v0.2.24 upgrades with the updater it has. Explicit rollback requires the exact rollbackCompatibleFrom array member.

Validation: both packages typecheck with zero errors; pnpm --filter web build succeeds; the BFF routing verification passes 124/124 across the ip, domain and tunnel Caddy templates (real Caddy → built Next BFF → synthetic API) including the two restored paths. CI re-runs the full API suite, typecheck, build, the BFF routing script, the static entry-point and bootstrap-contract checks, and both image builds. Nothing here asserts that the P4 production acceptance itself has passed — that still has to be run against production after this release is deployed.
